title: Illustrator John Cuneo
content: Illustrator John Cuneo, portrait by James GurneyLast weekend I sketched a quick portrait ofJohn Cuneoin water-soluble colored pencils and watercolors. His illustrations inNew YorkerandAtlantic Monthlyhave won a lot of awards, and onhis bloglately he has been drawing on menus and sketching what he calls "sad cartoons."
